recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It addresses remaining FHIR-25034 source inconsistencies without reopening the later FHIR-35948 offsets design or making unrelated SampledData changes.
issue_request: FHIR-25034 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and requested changing SampledData.period to SampledData.interval, adding SampledData.intervalUnit as a code with required UCUM binding, and updating surrounding descriptions that assumed time as the domain unit.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-25034-tagged source commit was found. The implicit application in beabb0eaac updated the active SampledData datatype spreadsheet from period to interval and added intervalUnit, but current source still lacked the required binding strength, retained time-point wording, and had a SampledData example using period without intervalUnit.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini shows SampledData is an active normative datatype, datatypes pages are active, Observation is an active resource, and old SampledData.period maps to current SampledData.interval. Later FHIR-35948 expanded SampledData with offsets and optional interval and is already represented on the combined branch, so this reconciliation preserved that later model.
reconciliation: Changed source/datatypes/sampleddata.xml to mark the local Units binding required and make SampledData.dimensions domain-neutral; changed source/datatypes.html to avoid time-only multidimensional wording; changed source/datatypes-examples.html to use interval plus intervalUnit="ms" instead of the removed period element; and updated related Observation example comments from period to interval.
source_changes: source/datatypes/sampleddata.xml: required the local Units binding to valueset-ucum-units and changed SampledData.dimensions from time-point wording to domain-neutral series wording.
source/datatypes.html: changed SampledData multidimensional narrative from time-point wording to series wording.
source/datatypes-examples.html: updated the SampledData example from period to interval and added intervalUnit="ms" in XML and JSON.
source/observation/observation-example-sample-data.xml: changed EKG SampledData comments from period to interval while preserving the existing ms intervalUnit values.

related_jiras.note: Later Published SampledData issue added offsets and made interval optional; it is already represented on the combined branch, and this FHIR-25034 fix preserves that model.
